mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate is held constant for two consecutive months above 5.25%, market expectations for future rate cuts increase, lowering real discount rates and boosting equity present-value pricing, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: FOMC holds or signals hold after a restrictive stance
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day average preceding the trigger (t-test p > 0.05) across 10 such events.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which raises consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by > 2% month-over-month AND UNRATE falls by > 0.2 percentage points in the same month
failure_condition: Across 10 such labor-market turning points, the 20-day forward return is negative or statistically indistinguishable from zero (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months predicts rising business confidence and supply-chain activity, which elevates equity valuation multiples and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 15 such INDPRO accelerations, the 5-day forward return is never positive (median negative).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 3% for two consecutive months, amid persistent high industrial production, suggests a disinflationary trend that reduces policy tightening risk and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 3.0 for two consecutive months AND INDPRO > 12-month MA for two consecutive months
failure_condition: During 8 such disinflation events, the 20-day forward return is negative in more than 70% of cases (binomial test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 4% for three consecutive months, without a corresponding increase in the federal funds rate, signals loss of central bank control and anticipatory equity market repricing of higher future inflation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 4.0 for three consecutive months AND FEDFUNDS < 2.5 for the same months
failure_condition: Across 5 such episodes, the 60-day forward return is not statistically lower than the 30-day average before the trigger (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in job openings (HOUST) accompanied by a sustained rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a cooling labor market, which reduces wage growth expectations and corporate profit forecasts, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls by > 10% month-over-month AND UNRATE rises by > 0.3 percentage points in the same month
failure_condition: During 8 such labor-market cooling events, the 20-day forward return is not statistically lower than the 30-day average before the trigger (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in consumer demand proxies (GDPC1) for three consecutive quarters, despite stable industrial production, suggests structural softening in the economy that lowers growth prospects and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Across 12 such quarters, the 60-day forward return is not persistently negative (median positive or zero).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid and sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% for two consecutive months, in the absence of a recession signal (e.g., INDPRO below 50), creates expectations of future easing and lowers real rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2.0 for two consecutive months AND INDPRO > 50 for the same months
failure_condition: During 6 such events, the 5-day forward return is not statistically higher than the 1-day average before the trigger (p > 0.05).
